errors.text_span: Die Balken sind in absteigender Reihenfolge angeordnet
errors.evidence: The bars are not arranged in descending order; they are grouped by material and year.
The description does not mention that the chart shows the share of Russian imports of industrial raw materials.
The description does not mention the legend, which indicates the color coding for the years 2021 (blue), 2022 (violet), and 2023 (gray).
The description does not mention the tick intervals on the vertical axis, which are in steps of 5%.
